ja: • コレクションサイズプラモデルシリーズの第10弾商品は、妖魔界のエリート妖怪「オロチ」。
• 龍のマフラーは３点で可動するうえ、口の開閉も可能。　付属のツボに入れて「ヘビ使い風」にしたり、龍の頭をオロチの手首に付け替えて「操り人形風」にしたり、プラモデルならではの遊びを楽しめる。
• 付属の表情シールを貼れば、さまざまなシーンを表現可能。
• 浮遊ポーズを再現する専用台座が付属。
成形品×6、シール×1、組立説明書×1
en: • The 10th product in the collection size plastic model series is the elite monster of the demon world, "Orochi."

• The dragon's muffler can move at three points, and its mouth can also be opened and closed. You can enjoy playing with plastic models by placing it in the included pot to make it look like a snake charmer, or by replacing the dragon's head with Orochi's wrist to make it look like a puppet.
• You can express various scenes by pasting the included facial expression seals.
• A special pedestal is included to recreate the floating pose.
Molded product x 6, Seal x 1, Assembly manual x 1
